About the role:

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.

You will:

  • Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

  • Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

  • Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

  • Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

  • Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

  • Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions

Required skills and experience:

  • 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

  • Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

  • Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

  • Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

raw_payload.title: Senior Solution Engineer
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data, AI, and complex enterprise architecture. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the data challenges of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, deliver compelling data-driven demonstrations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts that showcase measurable business outcomes.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion for transforming how organizations use data — from raw ingestion to real-time analytics to AI-powered applications. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are equally comfortable whiteboarding a medallion architecture with a data engineering team and presenting data ROI to a C-suite, and you bring deep opinions about what good data platform design looks like.

Location Requirement: Must be in North Carolina or South Carolina.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake's Data Cloud vision to data engineering leaders, analytics teams, data scientists, and executive stakeholders at prospects and customers

  • Lead hands-on technical discovery to map a customer's existing data architecture — pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, governance gaps — and design a Snowflake-native path forward

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and proof of concepts across Snowflake's full data platform: data engineering (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe), AI/ML (Cortex AI, ML model registry), and data sharing (Data Clean Rooms, Marketplace listings)

  • Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

  • Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

  • Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

  • Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

  • Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

  • Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

  • Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

  • A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

  • University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

  • Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

  • Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

 

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

 

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. About the Role This is a rare opportunity to partner directly with Replit’s President, Michele Catasta. As Replit leads in making useful intelligence accessible to all, you will serve as the company President's primary operational and strategic force multiplier across these critical organizations. Your mandate is to own the most complex cross-functional challenges, unblock technical and operational bottlenecks, and ensure that the core product, engineering, and organizational engines operate with speed, coherence, and precision. This is a high-leverage individual contributor (IC) role , not a traditional management track or team-building post. You will scale your personal leverage through AI workflows, agentic automation, and rigorous analytical judgment, influence, not headcount. You are the operator Michele turns to when an issue spans multiple disciplines such as technical architecture, product execution, support feedback loops, or organizational design and demands a single, decisive owner. What You’ll Do Act as Trusted Advisor & Operational Stand-in: Serve as a direct thought partner and proxy for Michele. Elevate core operational insights, synthesize briefings for high-stakes technical and organizational decisions, and step in as a representative when needed. Proactively Clear Cross-Functional Friction: Anticipate blind spots and resolve organizational bottlenecks before they escalate. Bridge natural seams between Engineering, Product, Support, AI teams to ensure high-cadence execution. Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for Complex Initiatives: Spearhead high-priority projects that lack a neat functional home such as evolving product unit economics, developer tooling infrastructure shifts, pricing models, or technical re-architectures. Scale Impact via AI & Automation: Actively build and deploy AI agents, automation pipelines, and modern operational workflows to multiply your personal bandwidth across status synthesis, metrics tracking, scenario modeling, and operational monitoring. What This Role Is Not Not a Routine Data / BI Role: You will not be building routine dashboards, running routine SQL queries, or handling standard quarterly analytics. Those belong to Data, RevOps, and Strategic Finance. Not Bureaucracy or Process for Process’s Sake: We prioritize momentum, rapid iteration, and decisiveness over heavy governance frameworks or dense slide decks. What We Look For 7+ Years in High-Growth Tech: Proven track record in strategy, operations, product operations, or technical chief of staff roles, with extensive time spent working shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product leadership. Cross-Domain Credibility: Strong technical fluency to earn the respect of Staff/Principal Engineers and AI researchers, paired with the operational empathy to partner effectively with Support and People teams. Exceptional Execution in Ambiguity: The ability to take ill-defined, sprawling problems, define clean problem boundaries, and drive them to resolution without formal line authority. Strong Quantitative & Analytical Toolkit: Deep comfort evaluating unit economics, interrogating technical systems data, building scenario models, and separating actionable signal from noise. Executive-Ready Communication: Direct, concise communicator who can deliver unambiguous trade-offs and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and brevity. Hands-on AI & Agent Automation: Active, practical experience leveraging LLM workflows, coding agents, and automation frameworks to amplify daily productivity and analytical depth. Presence & Proximity: Continual availability is essential. Ability to work in-person (at least) three days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) in Foster City, CA, collaborating closely on-site with leadership. Scale Experience: Experience navigating rapid organizational scaling while maintaining high cultural and engineering standards. Nice-to-Haves Deep Developer Tooling Background: Prior experience in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, AI coding assistants, or developer-focused software ecosystems. How We’ll Know It’s Working Decision Velocity Across Functions Increases: Product, engineering, and support initiatives move from scoping to execution faster, with clear alignment and measurable business impact. Net-Negative Friction: Teams actively seek your partnership because your involvement removes ambiguity, sharpens priorities, and unblocks progress rather than introducing overhead. Integrated Health Sightlines: Replit's President has continuous, high-signal visibility into the operating health, technical execution, and organizational sentiment across all reporting groups. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹

raw_payload.title: Product & Technical Communications
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You'll be responsible for:

  • Developing and articulating our long-term vision for the future of human-AI interaction, and what we’re building for developers and businesses.

  • Shaping the narrative around our products (in particular ElevenAgents), connecting our capabilities to emerging needs and trends in the wider world.

  • Leading storytelling and communications for top tier product launches, in partnership with product marketing, and running campaigns between launches to demonstrate the value our platform delivers.

  • Owning our security, privacy, and safety communications, including managing incident responses as part of a cross-functional team.

  • Producing superb written materials that advance our product story – including keynotes, talk tracks, social posts, and press releases – and creating scrappy product demos to show our technology in action.

  • Building the profile of our technical and product leadership, developing novel points of view, and supporting them with media, social, and event appearances.

  • Nurturing relationships with journalists, Substack writers, podcasters, technical creators, and other influencers who shape developer and enterprise buying decisions.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Run product or technical comms at a fast-paced B2B technology company, or built AI / software products.

  • A record of leading significant launches, and running effective product campaigns in between them.

  • Exceptional writing across different formats, with a talent for turning complex, technical topics into sticky narratives.

  • Experience working with security, safety, and engineering teams, and managing incidents.

  • Deep understanding of the independent media landscape and good relationships with some of the most influential commentators.

  • A track record of excellence, be that building products, running superb campaigns, or some other entrepreneurial endeavor.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT-4 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Mission

Role Purpose

We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the Central region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate, US. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets.

Neko is opening clinics at pace: the US plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade.

The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

• Pipeline management: identify, evaluate, and advance sites across Central markets including Texas, Chicago, the Midwest, Nashville, and Denver. Markets are TBD and could extend west or east depending on demand.

• Transaction execution: lead deals from initial market entry through signed lease, managing brokers, landlords, and timelines, at a pace set by the opening plan for the Central region.

• LOI negotiation: draft, negotiate, and revise LOIs; own the deal process end to end from first tour to final execution.

• Deal approval memos: build and present LOI and Lease Approval Memos with clear economics, risks, and a recommendation that stands up to executive scrutiny.

• Landlord relationships: build and maintain relationships with institutional and private landlords across the Central region.

• Broker coordination: manage tenant rep broker relationships across multiple markets simultaneously; hold brokers accountable to pipeline and timeline standards.

• Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Legal, Construction, Design, and Facilities to move deals from signed lease into buildout.

• Platform adoption: use Neko’s GIS site selection platform and lease administration system as the system of record and contribute to their rollout as the function scales.

Minimum Qualifications

• 3 to 7 years of real estate transaction experience, with meaningful time spent in-house at a healthcare, wellness, or high-growth retail company.

• You have personally led deals end to end, from site identification through LOI to signed lease, in competitive markets.

• Comfort working in a startup environment with real pressure, fast timelines, and limited infrastructure. You build as you go.

• A self-starter who does not need a fully defined playbook to do great work.

• Strong communication skills. You can represent Neko professionally with institutional landlords while keeping internal stakeholders informed concisely.

• Ability to read and pressure-test lease terms, rent schedules, and deal economics. You do not need to build financial models from scratch, but you need to know when a deal works and when it does not.

• Familiarity with GIS tools and lease administration platforms is a plus; willingness to learn them quickly is a must.

• AI: We use AI tools including Claude in daily work and expect you to use them too.

• Based in the Central United States. You should be within reasonable travel of the markets you cover.

raw_payload.title: ElevenMusic - Content Creator & Strategist
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is our AI music creation platform, letting anyone turn an idea into a finished, studio-grade track in minutes, with control over genre, mood, structure, and vocals across multiple languages. It is one of the most exciting parts of the ElevenCreative suite, and we want its voice, community, and content presence to match the ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own how ElevenMusic shows up in the world. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself.

What you will do

  • Create educational content and tutorial videos around ElevenMusic, recording, editing, and formatting them natively for each platform, and publish them across our socials

  • Make music with ElevenMusic constantly, testing the platform to its limits and turning experiments into content that shows creators what's possible

  • Provide structured, high-signal product feedback to the engineering team based on deep daily use, helping shape the roadmap

  • Own and manage the ElevenMusic social accounts, from content calendar and strategy through to publishing, engagement, and analytics

  • Help build and grow a community around ElevenMusic, sparking conversation, surfacing creator feedback, and championing standout work

  • Speak at creator events, representing ElevenMusic through talks, demos, and workshops

  • Plan and execute content around product launches and feature releases, coordinating with product, engineering, and Marketing

  • Stay ahead of trends in music creation, AI tools, and platform culture to find opportunities for the brand

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience creating music and music-related content, with a portfolio of work you can share, you are a genuine music maker, not just a marketer

  • Proven ability to produce educational content and tutorial videos end-to-end: recording, editing, adding text and motion, and formatting natively for platforms like X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

  • Experience managing social media accounts for a technology, music, or creative tools company, including content calendars, copywriting, and analytics

  • Comfortable presenting publicly, speaking at events, running demos or workshops, and being a visible face for the product

  • A genuine understanding of the AI and music creation landscape, you use the tools, follow the space, and have informed opinions about where things are headed

Bonus

  • Experience building or growing a creator community (Discord, forums, or similar)

  • Background as a working musician, producer, or music educator with an existing audience

  • Experience giving product feedback or working closely with engineering/product teams

  • Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar)

  • Multilingual capabilities

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead content and community strategy across ElevenMusic as the product and team scale

  • Move into a broader creative or content role spanning video, editorial, and social across ElevenLabs brands

  • Expand into creator partnerships, evangelism, or brand marketing as the growth team evolves

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. The Expansion Account Executive is responsible for building client relationships within Enterprise businesses. Individuals who excel at this job have the ability to prospect, develop, and close business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements. The Enterprise AE's must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with clients and support new customers through our on-boarding process. Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth. Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace. Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams. Arrange and conduct Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings. A track record of success in driving consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement. Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions. Pro-active, independent thinker with high energy and a positive attitude. Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills. Ability to thrive in fast-paced startup environment. Executive level relationship management. Ability to understand the "bigger picture" and the business drivers around IT. BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING: Experience implementing MEDDPICC. Experience selling software or cloud based applications is desired. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

About You

Most AE roles ask you to sell a product you only half understand to buyers who already know they want it. This is not that role. You'll sell a deeply technical product to developers, CTOs, and product teams — people who can smell a script from a mile away and will respect you more for going deep on the tech than for any closing line you've practiced. We don't have a polished playbook handed down from a head of sales who left three companies ago. We have a new sales leader, a market that's exploding faster than we can keep up with, and a real opportunity for the right person to help define the motion from the inside.

If you're energized by ambiguity, allergic to bureaucracy, and the kind of seller who genuinely enjoys learning why a customer is building what they're building — keep reading.

You'll thrive as an Account Executive if you:

  • are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • are focused on polish, detail and quality

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

 

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to demos, negotiation, and close

  • Develop deep product understanding and communicate technical value to developers, CTOs, and product teams

  • Generate pipeline through outbound efforts and strategic partnerships, with support from marketing and sales development

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects and customers, identifying their goals and how our platform helps them succeed

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to bring customer feedback into roadmap discussions and positioning

  • Help shape and evolve our sales playbook, messaging, and GTM motion as one of the earliest sales hires

  • Accurately forecast and track pipeline activity, working closely with leadership to inform strategy and planning

 

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of full-cycle SaaS sales experience, with at least 2 of those years selling into enterprise

  • A track record of consistently selling 6-figure deals and hitting or exceeding quota in fast-paced or early-stage environments

  • Strong instincts for selling technical products — APIs, developer tools, or infrastructure tooling — you don't shy away from going deep with technical buyers

  • Comfortable in low-process, high-autonomy environments and bringing structure where it's missing

  • Able to translate technical capability into business value for both technical buyers and executive stakeholders

  • High accountability, ownership, and bias for action — you don't wait to be told what the right next move is

  • Disciplined with CRM and pipeline hygiene (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling at an infrastructure or developer-tools company, ideally with multi-product or platform sales motion

  • Time spent as one of the earliest sellers at a startup — you know what it feels like to build the plane while flying it

  • A real interest in voice AI, agents, or real-time infrastructure (not just "AI" in your LinkedIn headline)

  • You once spent a Saturday building something with an API just to see if you could 😏

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flexible vacation policy

 

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

raw_payload.title: Technical Program Manager, MarTech & Mobile Measurement
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

  • Ready to run

  • Hungry and driven by urgency

  • Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

  • Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Our growth stack has a lot of moving parts. The app and the website send events through a customer data platform to the ad platforms, our mobile measurement partners and the data warehouse. Most launches touch several of those systems and a few different teams.

You'll own the growth roadmap and work day to day with the MarTech and growth engineers who build and maintain all of this. Your job is to keep launches moving, make sure they get properly tested, and make sure the numbers on the other side can be trusted.

What You'll Do

  • Own the growth roadmap. Turn requests from marketing, paid media and product into scoped tickets with clear owners and dates. Keep the roadmap, runbooks and data flow docs current, and automate the repetitive parts with scripts or AI tools.

  • Lead testing and QA with the MarTech and growth engineers. Write test plans, check changes in staging and on test devices before they ship, and confirm they worked after launch.

  • Keep data flowing into paid media. Manage customer data platform destinations, audience syncs, reverse ETL and server-side events. Watch for dropped events, low match rates and schema drift, and write or tweak simple scripts when a setting isn't enough.

  • Own our relationship with the mobile measurement partners. Debug attribution problems, keep SDK and ad network integrations healthy, and handle support escalations, renewals and roadmap requests.

  • Keep tracking specs consistent across the app, the website, the customer data platform and web analytics, and dig in when numbers from different sources don't match.

  • Run SDK upgrades, attribution migrations and new vendor onboarding from evaluation through cutover, with a rollback plan.

  • Support paid and acquisition work across search, social, app-install networks, app store search ads and affiliates, including click ID plumbing, exclusion lists and test setup.

  • Bring Privacy and Legal in early, so consent, data-sharing limits and data subject requests are part of the plan and not a surprise at launch.

You Bring

  • 8+ years in technical program management, supporting growth, performance marketing, martech or data teams.

  • Hands-on time with a customer data platform. You've connected it to several ad platforms, mapped and filtered events, and synced audiences with consent rules applied. You can read a tracking plan or a destination config and spot where a launch will break.

  • Experience with a mobile measurement partner and a good grasp of attribution: click IDs, ATT and SKAdNetwork, view-through versus click-through, and platform-reported versus first-party conversions. You've debugged discrepancies and dealt with the vendor directly.

  • Experience doing testing and QA with engineers on tracking or integration launches: test plans, staging checks, debug tools, test devices, and regression checks after SDK or release changes.

  • You write SQL and pull your own numbers.

  • A track record of running programs across engineering, design, data and marketing, with clear specs, honest status updates and a written record of decisions.

  • Good judgment on priorities, and comfort saying no. You're fine with ambiguity and with working asynchronously on a remote-first team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a consumer fintech or another regulated company.

  • Reverse ETL into paid media (conversion APIs, offline conversions, audience uploads) and keeping it healthy: match rates, deduplication, delays and dropped events.

  • Reading and writing simple scripts in JavaScript or Liquid, for example to transform an event payload or build a template.

  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse.

  • A working understanding of marketing privacy rules: consent, CCPA and similar state laws, GLBA, and limits on sharing customer data with ad platforms. You know when to ask Legal.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

  • 401(k) plan with company match

  • Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

  • A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

  • AI-assisted initial screen

  • Interview with Talent Partner

  • Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

  • Team Interview

  • Executive Interview

  • Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

raw_payload.title: Senior Program Manager, Life Sciences
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
Transform healthcare with us.

At Qualified Health, we're redefining what's possible with Generative AI in healthcare. Our infrastructure provides the guardrails for safe AI governance, healthcare-specific agent creation, and real-time algorithm monitoring, working alongside leading health systems to drive real change.

This is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to build the future of AI in healthcare, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on patient care. If you're ambitious, innovative, and ready to move fast, we'd love to have you on board.

Job Summary

Qualified Health's Life Sciences business is growing quickly, with work across several leading pharmaceutical organizations. Each organization has multiple brand teams with different objectives and leaders, and delivery runs from the pharma customer through our clinical, product, data, and engineering teams to health system IT and the care pathway workflows we deploy, often across more than one health system per program.

As Senior Program Manager, Life Sciences, you will be accountable to our customers for what we have committed to deliver. You will be the single source of truth for leadership and customers: defining and managing contractual scope, building and tracking delivery plans, knowing where every program stands, calling out problems before they become crises, and telling people early who needs to step in. The role is hands-on today and grows into leadership: you will build the PMO for Life Sciences and, as the business grows, hire and lead a team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and manage contractual scope for Life Sciences programs, and keep delivery aligned with customer commitments as work evolves.

  • Build and track delivery plans across customer, clinical, product, data, engineering, AI transformation, and health system IT teams, and course-correct early when work deviates from plan.

  • Surface risks and blockers proactively, say clearly what is blocking progress, and bring in the right leader at the right time.

  • When delivery drifts from plan, reset the plan and the conversation with the customer.

  • Give leadership and customers a single view of progress (green, yellow, red), including risks, issues, and what help is needed, and use AI tools to produce it quickly.

  • Own external customer communications, including recurring check-ins every 3 to 4 months with pharma stakeholders, with honest, polished updates on what is done and what is not.

  • Work with the teams that lead health system delivery so each program has one accountable view from commitment to deployment.

  • Help build the Life Sciences PMO, including its operating rhythm, templates, and reporting, and lead it as the function grows.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder programs end to end at a senior level, with hands-on ownership of scope, plans, risks, and status.

  • Experience in an external customer-facing role, including executive-level updates and steering committee style check-ins with customer stakeholders.

  • Track record of working across clinical, product, data, and engineering teams to deliver on commitments.

  • Strong skills in scoping work, building delivery plans, and managing issues, risks, and dependencies.

  • Active, practical use of AI tools in your current work, with examples of how you have applied them.

  • Proactive, clear communication with executives and customers, including comfort raising uncomfortable truths early.

  • High sense of urgency and comfort with ambiguity, with an owner's mindset.

  • Proficiency with project and task management tools (Notion, Jira, or similar). No single tool is required.

  • An undergraduate degree.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in life sciences or pharma programs, ideally on the commercial or program side, and familiarity with how pharma teams work.

  • Healthcare or health system experience.

  • Experience in a startup environment, or launching a new team or business inside a larger company.

  • Experience leading or building a team.

Why Join Qualified Health?

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a world-class team that is poised to change the healthcare industry. We are a passionate, mission-driven team building a category-defining product. We are backed by premier investors and are looking for founding team members who are excited to do the best work of their careers.

Our employees are integral to achieving our goals, so we are proud to offer competitive salaries with equity packages, robust medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and an inclusive environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we live in. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Pay & Benefits

The pay range for this role is between $170,000 and $200,000, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Join our mission to revolutionize healthcare with AI. To apply, please send your resume through the application below.

Job Summary

Qualified Health is hiring a Program Manager to help scale our Program Management Office (PMO) across health system customers. You will turn a strong foundation into a repeatable, transparent operating model, with real-time visibility into every program and clear audits of artifacts, compliance, governance, and information security.

You will partner closely with the existing PM, customer-facing teams, and internal leaders. You may spend more time with one customer at first, but the role is customer-agnostic and customer-facing, so you will represent the PMO with confidence and clarity across accounts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run day-to-day PMO operations across multiple customer programs, including weekly reporting, standing customer meetings, and follow-through on actions

  • Lead program audits across artifacts, compliance, governance, and information security, and identify gaps, access and data blockers, and anything that limits acceleration

  • Keep the PMO's source of truth current in Zoho and aligned with Notion, Slack, Jira, and Google Drive so program status is visible in real time

  • Build and refine a daily digest and reporting views that surface what matters across tools

  • Facilitate cross-customer working sessions where teams share what is working and exchange pilot and use-case learnings

  • Represent the PMO with customers and align stakeholders across customer, technical, and internal teams, including delivering difficult messages clearly

  • Trace recurring program issues to their root causes and turn the fixes into repeatable process improvements

  • Help lay the groundwork for workforce and resource tracking and for organizational effectiveness and readiness across internal and external teams

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex programs and stakeholders at once

  • Confident, clear customer-facing communication, including delivering difficult messages

  • Experience aligning stakeholders and working effectively across functions

  • Strong analytic thinking and root cause analysis

  • Experience with strategy and road-mapping, and with workforce or resource management

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, and with program and reporting tools such as Zoho, Jira, Notion, Slack, or Power BI

  • A builder mindset: you know when to run with something and when to ask for help

  • Active listening, emotional intelligence, executive presence, and humility, with comfort in ambiguity and a drive to create structure

Desirable Qualifications

  • Background in health AI, healthcare technology, or life sciences programs

  • Experience building real-time visibility or analytics for program health

  • Experience with compliance, governance, or information security audit processes

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a world-class team that is poised to change the healthcare industry. We are a passionate, mission-driven team building a category-defining product. raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is at an exciting inflection point, and we’re looking for a high-energy, creative marketing leader to own our marketing strategy for the Americas. As the Director of Americas Marketing, you won’t just be sitting in meetings—you’ll be the architect and the builder. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role where you’ll personally execute a regional go-to-market strategy that cuts through the noise of the crowded AI space. We need an out-of-the-box thinker who can bridge global strategy with local spark, making DeepL the go-to choice across the region.

You’ll be a one-person engine room, driving measurable impact across the funnel and partnering closely with Sales to crush regional revenue targets. If you love the challenge of personally launching campaigns that turn heads and win hearts, this is your stage. You’ll be a vital voice in our GTM leadership, translating big business objectives into high-impact, marketing programs.

This role reports directly to the VP of Demand Generation and sits at the heart of DeepL's go-to-market motion.

Your responsibilities

Regional Strategy & GTM Execution

  • Build and own the comprehensive marketing plan for the Americas, ensuring it is data-driven and aligned with both regional Sales priorities and global marketing initiatives

  • Partner with Global Performance & Campaigns and Digital Lifecycle teams to ensure global channel spend and lifecycle marketing are optimised for the Americas funnel, sparking high-quality pipeline growth across all segments, aligning with campaign managers to adapt global campaigns for the Americas

  • Drive regional ABM initiatives from concept to delivery, identifying high-value accounts and deploying tailored, creative messaging that stands out.

  • Provide strategic oversight for regional event management and field/partner marketing activities, ensuring events serve as a high-impact secondary channel for relationship building and lead generation.

  • Represent Marketing within the regional leadership team. Hold a seat at the table, building cross functional relationships, co-owning regional strategy with Sales and other leaders and building the regional culture together.

Funnel Analysis & Optimization

  • Own the end-to-end regional funnel analysis, monitoring trends from top-of-funnel traffic and conversions to pipeline health and closed-won revenue.

  • Proactively diagnose funnel friction, lead flow issues, or conversion gaps, and liaise with central teams—including Web, Marketing Operations, and Lifecycle—to resolve leaks and ensure a seamless, high-performing conversion path.

  • Partner with Regional SDR team, executing plays and pipe gen days to ensure regional pipeline targets are met

Collaboration & Execution

  • Operate as a high-velocity individual contributor who partners seamlessly with Global Marketing, Product Marketing, and regional Sales and SDR teams to deliver success.

  • Serve as the creative bridge between regional needs and global functions, advocating for local requirements while executing global initiatives with local flair.

  • Represent the Americas marketing motion at the senior level, owning the results, the budget, and the creative vision for the region.

  • Allocate and optimise regional marketing budget to ensure alignment with regional pipeline and revenue goals

  • Communicate marketing strategies, programs and expectations to regional GTM teams to ensure maximum impact on the business

Qualities we look for

  • 12–15 years of marketing experience, with a proven track record in B2B SaaS demand generation and regional leadership.

  • Expertise in building full-funnel marketing plans that support both high-velocity self-serve and complex enterprise sales motions.

  • Strong analytical mindset with a command of demand generation practices, including lead scoring, funnel metrics, and ROI analysis.

  • Demonstrated ability to be a collaborative partner to Sales, helping to translate regional sales goals into actionable marketing strategies.

  • Experience aligning with global functions (Performance, Digital, Field Marketing) to drive regional success within a global framework.

  • Deep familiarity with the B2B buying cycle — including the interplay between product-led growth, self-service revenue and assisted enterprise sales motions.

  • Exceptional analytical skills: you are comfortable defining KPIs, interpreting data and using insights to influence strategy and investment decisions at the leadership level, including applying AI-driven insights and predictive models.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts — you are a natural collaborator who can align diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, including driving adoption of AI-powered approaches across Marketing, Sales, and Product teams.

  • Excellent project management capabilities, with the ability to maintain clarity and momentum across multiple simultaneous campaigns and workstreams, leveraging automation and AI to increase speed and scale.

  • A practical, proactive mindset: you balance strategic thinking with a genuine willingness to get into the detail when it matters, including evaluating and implementing new AI tools and methodologies.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with several days in the office each week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

raw_payload.title: Vertical Sales Strategy and Operations
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

  • Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

  • Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

  • Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

  • Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

  • Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

  • Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

  • Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

  • Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

  • Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

  • Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space.

  • Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

raw_payload.title: Global Head of Facilities
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Neko Health operates physical spaces that are unlike anything else in healthcare. Our clinics are designed to the standard of a flagship retail experience: every surface, every material, every interaction is considered. Members notice. They come back. They tell others. That standard does not happen by accident. It is the result of deliberate operational craft applied at every level of the physical environment.

The Global Head of Facilities owns that craft at scale. You are responsible for the full spectrum of how Neko's spaces function and feel: hard and soft services, security, and health and safety across every market we operate in. You will set the global standard, lead a team of Regional Facilities Leaders, and build the systems that make exceptional spaces repeatable as we grow.

This role reports directly to the COO. It is a company-level position with influence over how Neko shows up physically to every member we serve.

 

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

Strategy & Standardisation

  • Define and own the global facilities strategy, setting consistent standards, operating procedures, and performance benchmarks across all markets

  • Build scalable playbooks, tooling, and reporting frameworks that allow the function to grow efficiently as new clinics and offices are added across geographies

  • Benchmark against best-in-class facilities and healthcare operations globally, continuously evolving the standard Neko holds itself to

Team Leadership & Regional Oversight

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of regional Facilities Managers, providing clear direction and accountability across markets

  • Establish the operating rhythm — cadences, escalation paths, and governance — that keeps regional teams aligned and performing consistently

  • Foster a high-performance culture that balances global standards with the autonomy regional managers need to execute locally

Expansion & Operational Readiness

  • Partner with Expansion, Operations, and Medical teams to develop a repeatable model for ongoing clinic maintenance, upkeep, and refresh cycles, ensuring every site continues to meet Neko's quality bar long after opening day

  • Oversee global vendor relationships and strategic service agreements, ensuring quality, consistency, and strong commercial terms across markets

  • Ensure all facilities meet applicable regulatory, safety, and healthcare compliance requirements, with a unified risk and emergency preparedness framework

Drive performance and financial rigour

  • Own the global facilities budget, allocating resources to protect quality and safety while identifying where smart efficiency is possible without compromising the member experience.

  • Define and track the KPIs that tell the true story of facilities performance globally, across hard services, soft services, security, and compliance, using data to identify trends before they become problems.

  • Report on facilities health and strategic priorities to the COO and Operations Leadership Team on a regular basis

     

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant leadership experience in facilities management, with 50+ premium high end consumer locations

  • Experience in premium retail, luxury hospitality, or consumer brand environments where physical standards are a direct expression of brand equity.

  • Demonstrated technical competence in hard services: you understand mechanical, electrical, and building systems well enough to hold specialist teams and contractors to account and to make sound decisions about maintenance strategy and capital investment.

  • A deep, personal commitment to physical environment quality: you have strong aesthetic sensibility and understand the operational disciplines that make excellent spaces sustainable, not just beautiful at opening.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience managing sizeable facilities budgets and complex vendor negotiations without sacrificing quality or safety standards.

  • Experience with facilities management platforms, data reporting tools, and a genuine enthusiasm for using technology to raise operational performance.

  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills: comfortable operating at COO level and equally credible with the regional team on the ground.

  • Comfortable with international travel to regional sites and markets as needed.

Preferred Experience

  • Relevant professional qualifications in facilities management, health and safety, or building services engineering (NEBOSH, IWFM, BIFM, or equivalent).

  • Track record of building a facilities team with genuine craft culture, not just a compliance mindset.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide on-site operational ownership for DDN storage systems and associated

EXAScaler/Lustre environments.

• Monitor storage health, availability, capacity, performance, alerts, and system

trends.

• Respond to incidents, service requests, and operational events in accordance

with agreed severity and response targets.

• Lead technical triage, fault isolation, recovery, and root-cause analysis for

storage, file-system, Linux, networking, and integration issues.

• Coordinate with customer operations teams, DDN Support, Engineering,

hardware vendors, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

• Maintain and troubleshoot EXAScaler/Lustre file systems, metadata services,

storage targets, client connectivity, failover, and recovery procedures.

• Support Kubernetes environments that consume DDN storage, including cluster

integration, persistent volumes, storage classes, access modes, and workloadlevel storage troubleshooting.

• Configure, validate, and troubleshoot CSI drivers and related Kubernetes storage

components

Investigate issues across the Kubernetes-to-storage path, including pods, nodes,

kubelet, CSI controller and node plugins, APIs, mounts, permissions,

networking, and backend storage.

• Support NFS, parallel file-system, block, and other storage access protocols

where applicable.

• Perform planned maintenance, upgrades, expansions, migrations, hardware

replacements, and configuration changes using approved change-management

processes.

• Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures,

recovery procedures, escalation guides, and troubleshooting documentation.

• Conduct regular health checks, capacity reviews, performance assessments,

and operational-readiness reviews.

• Identify risks, recurring failure patterns, single points of failure, and opportunities

to improve reliability and automation.

• Validate backup, restore, replication, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity

procedures where applicable.

• Support capacity forecasting for storage, metadata, network, client, and datagrowth requirements.

• Assist with performance benchmarking, workload analysis, tuning, and servicelevel reporting.

• Maintain accurate configuration management, asset records, incident records,

problem records, and installed-base information.

• Participate in on-call, out-of-hours, or escalation coverage as required by the

customer environment.

• Provide technical briefings, knowledge transfer, and operational training to

customer teams.

• Contribute to implementation schedules, risk and mitigation plans, acceptance

testing, handover, and customer sign-off.

Required Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering,

Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• At least 5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, storage

administration, systems administration, data-centre operations, or a related

field.

• Hands-on experience supporting enterprise storage, HPC, AI, cloud, or highperformance computing environments.

• Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.

+1.800.837.2298 · services@ddn.com · ddn.com

• Experience with DDN storage platforms and/or EXAScaler/Lustre environments.

• Experience with file systems such as Lustre, NFS, GPFS, or other parallel or

distributed file systems.

• Working knowledge of Kubernetes architecture and day-to-day cluster

operations.

• Working knowledge of the Container Storage Interface, including CSI controllers,

node plugins, volume lifecycle operations, mounts, snapshots, expansion, and

topology considerations.

• Experience troubleshooting persistent storage consumed by Kubernetes

workloads.

• Strong understanding of IP networking, Ethernet, InfiniBand, or other high-speed

interconnects.

• Ability to interpret system logs, Kubernetes events, CSI logs, metrics, alerts, and

performance data.

• Experience with monitoring, observability, and alerting platforms.

• Experience with incident management, problem management, change

management, and technical escalation processes.

• Ability to troubleshoot methodically across hardware, operating systems,

storage, file systems, Kubernetes, networking, and application layers.

• Strong understanding of data-centre fundamentals, including power, cooling,

rack layouts, cabling, remote management, and hardware replacement

procedures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently on a customer site while collaborating effectively

with distributed technical teams.

• Willingness and ability to participate in on-call or after-hours support when

required.

Desirable Skills:

• Experience supporting large-scale or rapidly growing storage environments.

• Experience with Kubernetes distributions such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE

Rancher, VMware Tanzu, or equivalent platforms.

• Familiarity with Helm, Operators, Custom Resource Definitions, YAML, and

Kubernetes troubleshooting tools.

• Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, or

comparable observability platforms.

• Working knowledge of Ansible, Python, Bash, or other automation technologies.

• Experience with Git-based configuration management and infrastructure-ascode practices.

+1.800.837.2298 · services@ddn.com · ddn.com

• Familiarity with S3 or object-storage concepts and data-movement tools.

• Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as LDAP,

Active Directory, Kerberos, and TLS certificates.

• Knowledge of DNS, NTP, DHCP, routing, VLANs, MTU, firewall policies, and

network troubleshooting.

• Experience with high-availability design, quorum, failover, replication, and

disaster recovery.

• Familiarity with ITIL-based service management processes.

• Experience preparing operational reports, service reviews, capacity forecasts,

and executive summaries.

• Relevant certifications in Linux, Kubernetes, cloud, networking, or storage.

• Knowledge of Mandarin Chinese would be an advantage
