raw_payload.title: Marketing Engineer, Discoverability
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

The Role
We're hiring an organic growth expert to own AEO and SEO at Profound. You’ll lead how we grow through AI answer engines, supported by a strong foundation in traditional search, and turn that visibility into qualified demand and pipeline.

You'll use Profound every day to grow Profound. That means finding where we're missing from relevant conversations, understanding which sources shape the answers, and getting changes live. You'll also bring what you learn back to our Product team and help us show customers and the broader market what effective AEO looks like in practice. Help us define what good marketing looks like at the frontier of brand discoverability.

What You'll Do

  • Own our organic growth strategy. Build and execute a roadmap for how Profound gets discovered, cited, and recommended across AI answer engines and traditional search. Prioritize the questions, topics, and sources that matter most to our market.

  • Turn data into published work. Use search demand, prompt data, citation decay, and competitive gaps to decide what we should create and update. Work with Content and subject matter experts to publish fresh and custom content on a near-constant basis.

  • Keep the site technically sound. Partner with Web and Engineering on crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, internal linking, and structured data. Write clear implementation briefs and verify the changes.

  • Build our presence beyond our website. Identify the publications, communities, and other sources that appear in answers about our category. Work with PR, Partnerships, and Social to earn relevant coverage and contribute useful expertise.

  • Run disciplined experiments. Test content formats, page structures, technical changes, and distribution approaches. Document what changed, what happened, and what the evidence supports.

  • Build repeatable workflows. Use Profound’s AI Marketer to speed up research, audits, monitoring, and reporting. Keep human review where accuracy and editorial judgment matter.

  • Understand our market. You look beyond keywords to understand what buyers are trying to solve and what would move them toward an evaluation or purchase.

  • Connect visibility to business results. Track search performance, AI mentions and citations, qualified traffic, conversions, and pipeline. Be clear about what we can measure and where attribution is incomplete.

  • Inform how we build Profound. Share product feedback from running our own program. Turn useful findings into examples, research, and playbooks our customers can apply.

  • Help define the role of the Marketing Engineer. Share what you learn, publish outcomes from our experiments, and develop a clear point of view on what works. Bring that expertise to industry conversations.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in SEO or organic growth, with experience owning a program and delivering measurable results. We weigh what you've built more heavily than time in seat.

  • You've run hands-on AEO experiments and can explain what you tested, how you measured it, and what you learned.

  • You understand technical SEO well enough to diagnose problems, prioritize fixes, and work through implementation with engineers.

  • You have strong editorial judgment. You can write a useful brief, edit a page yourself, and recognize when content needs original expertise or research.

  • You use AI tools regularly and can build or adapt workflows with APIs, scripts, or automation platforms.

  • You can distinguish a promising signal from a result that needs more testing, and explain both clearly.

  • You can make complex ideas easy to understand by translating technical concepts into clear recommendations and connection to business impact.

  • You take ownership from recommendation through execution. You're comfortable making decisions, collaborating across teams, and adjusting quickly as you learn.

Compensation & Benefits

This is an on-site role in our New York office—designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $100,000–$200,000, plus equity and a full suite of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on your experience and fit.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

description: About LiveKit LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year. About This Role: A lot of technical recruiting jobs at startups are a sprint: a big hiring push, a pile of reqs, then a hiring freeze and a reorg. This isn't that. Our engineering hiring is steady and it's going to stay that way, so we want someone who'd rather go deep with a handful of engineering teams than churn through whatever's on fire this week. The tradeoff: you'll be expected to actually understand what you're hiring for and how your work impacts the business overall. You'll be a Talent Business Partner to the LiveKit team. You'll thrive as a Senior Technical Recruiter if you: are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems are focused on polish, detail and quality are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement AI in the recruiting process 😊 What You'll Do Own 8-10 engineering and technical searches end to end, from kickoff to signed offer Partner with engineering hiring managers on what the role really needs, and push back when the requirements don't match the market Source hard: find the infra, backend, SDK, and AI engineers who aren't looking, and give them a reason to talk to us Understand what candidates are motivated by and create a strategy to get them there Build pipelines for the roles we hire for again and again, so new reqs don't start from zero Run an honest, authentic and clear process emphasizing candidate experience that people talk about, even the ones we don't hire Help build the systems the Talent team runs on, from sourcing playbooks to interview kits Who You Are 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting, mostly in-house You've owned senior and staff-level engineering searches and closed them You can hold a real conversation with an engineer about their work You source proactively and know how to build and sustain a strong bench. You've recruited for infrastructure, developer tools, open source, or AI companies You've built or rebuilt a recruiting process from scratch You know how to win top talent, even when competing against offers from big tech. Nice to Have You've used Ashby and Gem (or have strong opinions about the tools you did use) Are Located in San Francisco Have a degree or certificate in computer science Have experience with executive recruiting Our Commitment to You An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world Competitive salary and equity package Health, dental, and vision benefits Flexible vacation policy

Oracle Technical Project Manager — E-Business Suite and Fusion

Center of Excellence | Working alongside Tessera AI Agents

Remote, USA

 

Location: Near-shore (Latin America) or offshore (e.g., India). Both are open, and we will evaluate strong candidates from either.

 

Remote: Yes, with a daily overlap of US business hours (full overlap for near-shore, at least 3–4 hours for offshore) and occasional travel to customer sites for kick-offs and go-lives as needed.

 

Experience: 12+ years

 

Employment type: Long-term contract, engaged directly or through a staffing partner.

 

Positions: 1

 

Start date: Immediate.

 

Engagement model: Multi-engagement delivery management role. Approximately 80% running several concurrent Oracle engagements — proofs of value, discovery and implementation work across E-Business Suite and Fusion — and 20% delivery standards, platform input and pre-sales support. Works with a daily overlap of US business hours alongside customers, Oracle architects and SMEs, Forward Deployed Engineers and the Principal Architects.

About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

 

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Oracle Technical Project Manager to run Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud engagements — several at the same time — from kick-off to go-live. Our architects decide what the solution should be; you make sure it gets built, tested, converted and cut over on the date we committed to, and that the customer can see exactly where it stands at every point in between.

 

This is a technical project management role, and that is deliberate. You need to know Oracle delivery well enough to manage the deliverables themselves, not just the dates: the RICEFW inventory, functional and technical specifications, configuration moving between environments, data conversion mock cycles, integration builds, test cycles and the cutover runbook. A project manager who cannot tell whether a mock conversion actually reconciled, or why a Fusion quarterly update threatens the test plan, will report green until the week it turns red.

 

Most of our customers are not simply upgrading Oracle. They come from SAP ECC, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft, Infor or home-grown systems, and many run EBS and Fusion side by side. Our engagements are also shorter and sharper than a traditional system integrator’s: proofs of value measured in weeks, with success criteria agreed up front and evidence of value expected at the end.

 

You will run these engagements with Tessera’s AI agents as part of the team, and you need to be genuinely fluent in using AI. The platform produces a large share of the analysis, specifications, configuration, code and test material. Your job is to plan around that: build review and approval gates into the plan, know where AI output needs a domain expert’s eye, track the value it delivers against the manual baseline, and use AI tools yourself to plan, report and spot risk faster. What the platform cannot do is hold a steering committee to a decision or tell a customer that the date is at risk. That is the role.

 

Two outcomes define the job. The first is engagements that land: on the date, inside the scope, with the customer’s sign-off and a reference we can use. The second is that each one makes the next easier to run, because what you learn goes into our delivery standards and the platform rather than staying in your head.

Key Responsibilities

1. Engagement Planning and Governance (25%)

  • Own the plan on several concurrent Oracle engagements: scope, phases, milestones, dependencies, resourcing and the critical path — from discovery and fit-gap through build, testing, data conversion, cutover and hypercare.

  • Set up and run governance: weekly checkpoints, daily syncs during execution, steering committees, RAID logs and clear escalation paths — and report status the customer’s executives can trust.

  • Manage scope, budget and commercial terms: burn and forecast against fixed-fee and time-and-materials engagements, change requests and change orders, with no surprises for the client partner or the customer.

  • Agree success criteria for proofs of value up front and track them through to an evidence-based close-out.

2. Management of Technical Deliverables (35%)

  • Own the RICEFW inventory (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) and drive each item through specification, build, review, test and sign-off.

  • Manage functional and technical specifications, code and configuration as deliverables — with review gates, quality criteria and traceability from requirement to test.

  • Plan and control environments and configuration movement: EBS instance strategy, cloning and patch windows (including R12.2 online patching); Fusion environment refreshes, Functional Setup Manager migrations and the quarterly update cycle.

  • Run data conversion as a managed workstream: mock conversion cycles, reconciliation sign-off, defect tracking and readiness criteria for each load.

  • Coordinate integration builds and third-party dependencies — banks, tax engines, payroll, EDI and legacy systems — and the testing between them.

  • Lead test management (CRPs, SIT, UAT, regression for Fusion quarterly updates) with entry and exit criteria, defect triage cadence and go/no-go evidence.

  • Plan and run cutover: an hour-by-hour runbook, rehearsals, go/no-go criteria, rollback and contingency plans, and hypercare.

3. AI-Enabled Delivery (20%)

  • Plan engagements around AI-generated work: where the Tessera platform produces analysis, specifications, configuration, code and test scripts, and where human review and approval gates sit in the schedule.

  • Work with Tessera’s Forward Deployed Engineers and domain SMEs to keep AI output grounded and validated, and escalate early when a deliverable needs expert attention.

  • Measure and report the value AI delivers — time and effort saved against the manual baseline, quality of output, and adoption by the customer’s team.

  • Use AI tools in your own work every day: drafting plans, status reports and meeting summaries, analysing risks and dependencies, and preparing steering committee material.

  • Apply sound judgment on data privacy and security when AI is used on customer data, in line with the customer’s policies and our agreements.

4. Client Leadership, Standards and Pre-Sales (20%)

  • Be the primary delivery counterpart for the customer’s program office and IT leadership, and build the trust that turns a proof of value into a follow-on engagement.

  • Manage organisational change and readiness with the customer: training, communication and business sign-offs, so go-live is adopted, not just executed.

  • Contribute to Tessera’s Oracle delivery standards — plan templates, RACI, governance packs, cutover runbooks and lessons learned — and feed field input to the platform team.

  • Support pre-sales with delivery plans, staffing models, timelines and risk assessments for proposals and statements of work.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years in project or program management, including at least three full-lifecycle Oracle ERP implementations as project manager — covering both Oracle E-Business Suite (R12.x) and Oracle Fusion Cloud, at least one of each.

  • At least one engagement where the customer moved to Oracle from a different ERP, such as SAP ECC, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft or Infor.

  • Hands-on experience managing technical deliverables on Oracle implementations: RICEFW inventories, functional and technical specifications, configuration migration, data conversion mock cycles, integrations, test cycles and cutover runbooks.

  • Working knowledge of Oracle delivery methods — Oracle Unified Method (OUM) for EBS and Oracle’s cloud implementation approach for Fusion — and of the Fusion quarterly update cycle and Oracle Support service request management.

  • Practical, everyday fluency with AI: using generative AI and agentic tools in your own work, and experience — or a clear point of view — on planning and governing delivery where AI produces part of the work.

  • Strong commercial and governance discipline: budgets, burn and forecast, change control, RAID management and steering committees.

  • Senior client-facing presence: able to hold a steering committee, deliver bad news early and keep the relationship.

  • Proven ability to run several engagements at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months.

  • Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences.

  • Experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Who This Role Is Not For

If your project management stops at the plan and the status report, this is not the role — you will be expected to understand and manage the technical deliverables themselves. If you have run ERP programs but never an Oracle implementation through cutover, you will find the learning curve steep on our timelines. If you are sceptical of AI or prefer to keep it at arm’s length, you will struggle in a delivery model where AI agents produce a large share of the work. And if you want one long program with a scope someone else agreed, you will find several short, high-pressure engagements uncomfortable.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A technical or functional background in Oracle before moving into project management — for example as a developer, DBA, data conversion lead or module consultant.

  • Experience running proofs of value or pilot engagements with defined success criteria and measured outcomes.

raw_payload.title: Production Coordinator
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
The Company

AnySignal is developing the next generation of RF products and services for some of the most demanding space and defense missions. We’re building a flexible, high-performance platform that’s easy to deploy, monitor, and scale — enabling customers to bring advanced radio technologies to life faster than ever before.

 

The Role

We’re hiring a Production Coordinator to join our production team to coordinate and track inventory throughout our facility. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to shape how a growing company manufacturing space and defense RF communication platforms..

Expect to move between coordinating and performing your responsibilities while working closely with purchasing, supply chain and manufacturing.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, track, and move parts as required through the production flow to ensure timely delivery to the next production location

  • Coordinate physical movement of parts through receiving inspection, stock rooms, purchasing, production resources

  • Ensure parts are handled and appropriately protected within AnySignal specifications

  • Coordinate off-site processing of parts to ensure on-time delivery as required

  • Work with the planning, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure MRP/ERP data is and remains clean and accurate

  • Assist with the resolution of incorrect system data which is driving inappropriate demand, schedules, or could result in general failure

  • Analyze available data and develop metrics as required to drive optimal results

  • Develop and maintain reports to highlight needs, deliverables, and constraints as required for internal and customer use

  • Communicate part status and estimated completion dates to leadership weekly

  • Support logistics process through innovative staging of workflow as required

  • Assist production leadership and project teams with action item updates as required

  • Support management of material certifications as required; prevent use of un-certified materials

  • Work with production supervisors and managers to ensure all metrics driven action requirements are completed

  • Support production and inventory personnel with “return to stock” and inventory purge actions

  • Support purchase requisition creation for scheduled contract work as required

  • Organize and maintain the physical and electronic library for production related tooling and calibration database as required

  • Support projects or productivity development activities within assigned production cells

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate

  • 1+ years of experience in an administrative role

Preferred Skills

  • Strong computer skills, familiar with the full suite of MS Office products

  • 1+ years of Inventory experience and experience organizing files and documents

  • Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems

  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronic manufacturing environment

  • SQL and Tableau experience

  • APICS certification

Compensation

The estimated base salary range for this role is $25-$30 per hour, plus equity. This range reflects our good-faith estimate for this position at the time of posting. The final base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and market considerations. In addition to base salary, total compensation includes an equity grant and our full benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision), HSA's and 401K program.

 

Export Control Requirements

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the necessary authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

 

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

AnySignal is committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including women, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and members of underrepresented communities.

 

If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us in confidence at careers@anysignal.com. We are committed to ensuring equal access for all applicants.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

If your pre-sales experience is running the demo rather than owning the solution, the same applies. And if you prefer one engagement at a time with a clear scope agreed by someone else, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for a senior Oracle architect who is at ease holding several unfinished things at once in various stages of the sales cycle and delivery.

  • Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context.

  • Experience working within the Oracle partner and co-sell ecosystem, including Oracle PartnerNetwork (OPN).

  • Oracle Unified Method (OUM) or equivalent implementation methodology experience across multiple full-lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud programs.

  • Oracle Cloud certifications, for example Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, Procurement or SCM Implementation Professional.

  • Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must-have.

raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
COMPANY

At 0x, our mission is to "Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely". We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience.

Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M+ transactions and $180B+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto.

When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning.


About the role

We’re hiring a Head of Marketing to take 0x through its next stage of growth. You’ll join our leadership team, report directly to our founder and CEO, and own marketing strategy across 0x APIs, our suite of onchain trading APIs, and Matcha, our consumer DEX aggregator.

You’ll own the narrative behind both brands. You’ll build on our strong footing with cryptonative teams while defining how we take our APIs to fintechs, enterprises and institutions. We’re looking for someone who understands DeFi deeply, thinks from first principles and builds for the long term.

You’ll lead a senior marketing team, unite them around clear priorities and build one cohesive, high-impact marketing function. You’re as comfortable doing the work as you are leading it. You’ll stay close to the business, joining key customer conversations and getting directly involved in positioning and major launches.

Strong overlap with US working hours is required.

What you'll do

  • Own marketing strategy across 0x APIs and Matcha, setting long-term marketing plans based on company and product goals, including API adoption and Matcha's consumer growth.

  • Refine positioning and narratives for 0x APIs and Matcha, defining and maintaining clear ICPs, strengthening our cryptonative presence, and expanding 0x APIs' appeal to fintechs, enterprises, and institutions.

  • Guide the evolution of both brands, setting creative and website direction and ensuring a distinctive, consistent presence across channels.

  • Build and scale marketing programs that drive growth, identifying the highest-leverage opportunities for each product and audience.

  • Partner closely with Sales to generate qualified API demand, align marketing with commercial priorities, and equip the team with the content and materials needed to win customers.

  • Lead the marketing team, setting clear priorities and ownership, automating and improving processes with AI, giving constructive feedback and coaching experienced marketers, and protecting their focus by managing cross-team requests.

  • Produce work yourself, from positioning and launch plans to campaigns and content, adding to the team’s output and stepping in wherever extra capacity is needed.

  • Own marketing performance and budget, tracking spend, ROI and marketing’s contribution to revenue, and keep the company informed on progress.

  • Stay deep in the data, using Dune, DefiLlama and internal analytics to understand market trends, competitors and product adoption, and let it guide marketing decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years in marketing, including 3+ years leading a marketing function.

  • Experience setting company-wide marketing strategy across multiple product lines, shaping distinct positioning and narratives for the audiences each one serves.

  • Experience marketing both technical B2B products, ideally APIs or core infrastructure, and consumer products.

  • Deep roots in crypto, including time at a crypto company. You use DeFi products, follow CT, and know how DEXs, aggregators, liquidity providers, wallets and trading apps fit together and where infrastructure like 0x creates value.

  • A track record of building repeatable marketing programs that drove measurable business growth.

  • Experience leading senior marketers as a player-coach and bringing them together as a cohesive, focused team.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a DEX, aggregator or onchain trading infrastructure company.

BENEFITS

  • The base salary range for this position is USD $200,000 - $300,000 + equity + ZRX tokens + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, location, business needs, and candidate preferences between the different compensation elements.

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision/life/disability) for U.S.-based employees — 100% of base plan covered for you and dependents

  • 401k and FSA for U.S.-based employees

  • Monthly mobile phone bill, wellness, and pre-tax transportation expense

  • Covered mental health benefits (included professional therapy sessions)

  • A supportive remote environment

  • Lunch reimbursement for all employees across the globe!

  • Stipend for your ideal remote / WFH set-up: headphones, and any other work gear you may need

  • 12-week paid parental leave

  • Great office conveniently located in the SF Financial District for those in the region!

  • Flexible vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

0x and its associated entities are dedicated to fostering diversity, inclusion, and belonging in its teams and workforce, and are proud to be equal opportunity employers. 0x does not make employment or hiring decisions on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex (including those who are pregnant or have given birth), sexual orientation, gender, gender expression or identity, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, political affiliation, or any other basis that is protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This includes not making such decisions based on the status itself, as well as any associations, perceptions, and assumptions made regarding these statuses. 0x will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a way that is consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity extends to ensuring that all applicants and employees can perform to their fullest potential, including through obtaining reasonable accommodations when necessary.

raw_payload.title: IT Support Engineer
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are hiring an IT Support Engineer to own the employee technology experience end to end — from day-one device readiness through the full asset lifecycle. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable resolving a Tier 3 macOS escalation, standing up device management infrastructure from scratch, and turning repetitive support work into documented, self-service processes.

You will be the technical escalation point for our Windows and macOS fleet, administer our identity and endpoint management platforms, and partner with security to keep the fleet patched and compliant. You will also mentor junior support staff and set the standard for white-glove service across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint & Device Management

  • Be the front line supporting MDM platforms across the fleet in collaboration with our Technical Engineer — Supporting Windows & macOS — including enrollment, configuration profiles, group policies, and software distribution.

  • Serve as the Tier 1/2 escalation point for macOS and Windows device management issues, including configuration drift, update failures, and security policy conflicts.

  • Work with Technical Engineers to standardized OS images and deployment workflows on a quarterly cadence.

  • Monitor endpoint performance and digital employee experience to identify emerging issues before they scale, and drive proactive remediation across the fleet.

  • Execute workstation imaging, setup, and deployment for new hires and internal transfers, scaling to 100+ builds per month during peak hiring.

Identity & Access Management

  • Tier 1 /2 — provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, and application access requests.

  • Tier 1 /2 supporting authentication methods including FIDO2 security keys, passkeys, and biometric authentication.

  • Troubleshoot via remote sessions with Slack Huddle, Zoom, or Google Meet.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with the IT Engineering team on patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint compliance using tools such as BigFix, SentinelOne, or Automox.

  • Exposure in supporting security-driven remediation tickets within SLA and maintaining fleet compliance against internal and regulatory standards.

Service Delivery & Support

  • Own a high-volume ticket queue in ServiceNow or Jira, consistently meeting or beating SLA targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

  • Provide in-person and remote support to a globally distributed workforce across North America and EMEA time zones.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace issues including sync failures, authentication errors, mail flow, and collaboration tooling (Teams, Zoom, SharePoint).

  • Support conferencing and telephony systems for internal and executive-level meetings.

Asset Lifecycle & Vendor Management

  • Provide asset management support to help track and manage our computer hardware and software.

  • Asset shipping and recovery for our new joiners and leavers.

Enablement

  • Lead new-hire IT onboarding sessions covering workstation setup, security protocols, and support procedures.

  • Author and maintain runbooks and self-service documentation in Confluence or SharePoint to reduce repeat ticket volume.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in IT support, end user services, or systems administration.

  • Strong hands-on expertise troubleshooting both Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment.

  • Production experience administering at least one major MDM platform (JAMF Pro, Microsoft Intune, Addigy, or equivalent), including building configuration profiles and policies from scratch.

  • Working knowledge of identity platforms — Okta, Active Directory, or Entra ID — including SSO and MFA administration.

  • Experience with endpoint security and patch management tooling (BigFix, SentinelOne, Automox, Zscaler, or similar).

  • Proficiency with an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) and a track record of meeting SLA commitments at volume.

  • Strong administration skills in Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal process and high ambiguity, and to build structure where none exists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a white-glove approach to customer service across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • JAMF Certified Tech (JAMF 200) or higher; Microsoft, Okta, or CompTIA certifications.

  • Linux fundamentals and experience administering virtual machines (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V).

  • Experience supporting file share, print, or application servers on Windows Server.

  • Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).

  • Reporting and dashboarding experience with Power BI or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting users across multiple international regions.

Success in the First 6 Months

  • Fully ramped on the fleet and operating independently as the Tier 3 escalation point for Windows and macOS.

  • Measurable reduction in average time-to-resolution and repeat ticket volume through documentation and automation.

  • Onboarding and imaging workflows standardized, documented, and consistently delivering day-one readiness.

  • Endpoint compliance sustained at or above target across the fleet.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 40 lbs.

  • Onsite presence required for imaging, deployments, hardware repair, and in-person support.

  • Occasional after-hours or weekend work for maintenance windows, migrations, and escalations.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

About the Role:

The Sr. Principal Support Partner Manager is Gen’s primary liaison and strategic partner for outsourced contact center operations. This role leads the partner strategy and day-to-day relationship, driving service excellence, operational performance, and value. The manager establishes and monitors KPIs, ensures improvement plans are executed, oversees partner budgets and forecasts, and serves as the primary escalation point for Gen teams and partner leadership.

Working cross-functionally with Workforce Management (WFM), Training, Quality, and Global Operational Risk Governance, this role ensures outsourced operations are aligned with service targets and business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

· Lead the outsourced contact center strategy and drive partner performance to exceed key performance indicators and business objectives.

· Extract, monitor, analyze, and validate KPI and service-level data to assess partner performance and identify trends.

· Identify operational efficiencies and recommend best practices to improve service and performance.

· Partner with WFM and VMO leadership to align staffing forecasts, billable hours, and budgets; manage partner budgets and forecasts with fiduciary responsibility.

· Work with Procurement on partner contract negotiations, maintain partner contracts, and support strong contractual adherence.

· Oversee successful day-to-day operations across outsourced partners, including the execution and deployment of new initiatives.

· Lead and report weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews.

· Solicit feedback from internal stakeholders and lead closed-loop feedback with partners.

· Manage operating expenses and end-to-end invoice reconciliation.

· Monitor partner compliance with internal and regulatory requirements and ensure appropriate controls and processes are in place.

About you:

· Education: Bachelor’s degree; MBA preferred. COPC certification is an advantage.

· Experience: 8+ years managing an internal or outsourced call center.

· Experience managing outsourced partners in a fast-paced environment and with contact center technology is required.

· Leadership experience in a multilingual support contact center is a plus.

· Financial products experience is preferred, but not required.

Skills:

· Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present to diverse internal and external audiences.

· Ability to work with complex mathematical concepts and statistics to document, report, compare, and draw conclusions from partner-performance and campaign data.

· Strong planning and execution skills, including the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.

· Ability to work independently, stay self-motivated, manage time effectively, and be resourceful in complex situations.

· Experience using AI tools and automation for vendor management and performance tracking, with openness to emerging technologies that streamline vendor processes.

Personal Attributes:

· Self-directed and resourceful, with sound judgment and contingency plans for complex situations as needs arise.

· Organized and adaptable, able to balance competing priorities while maintaining accountability for plans and results.

What’s Next

After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

· TA Call

· Hiring Manager Interview (virtual)

· Key Partner Interviews

description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F , led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products. THE ROLE As a Solutions Architect at Baseten you will partner closely with Sales and customers to translate business needs into technical solutions, run technical discovery, and guide repeatable deployments and proofs of value for customers. This role is a great fit for entrepreneurial, customer-facing technical professionals who want a front-row view into how modern companies adopt AI at scale, and who enjoy working across technical discovery, solution design, demos, deployment scoping, and hands-on customer implementations, in close partnership with Sales and Engineering. RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with Sales on customer discovery calls (most often second calls, occasionally first calls for large accounts). Lead demos and technical scoping to align on success criteria, architecture, and deployment approach. raw_payload.title: Solutions Architect, EMEA
raw_payload.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE
As a Solutions Architect at Baseten you will partner closely with Sales and customers to translate business needs into technical solutions, run technical discovery, and guide repeatable deployments and proofs of value for customers. This role is a great fit for entrepreneurial, customer-facing technical professionals who want a front-row view into how modern companies adopt AI at scale, and who enjoy working across technical discovery, solution design, demos, deployment scoping, and hands-on customer implementations, in close partnership with Sales and Engineering.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with Sales on customer discovery calls (most often second calls, occasionally first calls for large accounts).

  • Lead demos and technical scoping to align on success criteria, architecture, and deployment approach.

  • Own benchmarking and repeatable deployments, including:

  • Handling standard deployment patterns and configurations across many modalities – LLMs, embeddings, image and video generation, Voice AI, etc.

  • Advising on tradeoffs like H100s vs B200s and latency-optimized vs throughput-optimized setups.

  • Driving consistent “playbook” style deployments for common models and use cases.

  • Become a power user of different runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, and TRT-LLM and all the common configurations and tradeoffs between them

  • Drive POC and project execution, including:

  • Scoping POCs and keeping stakeholders aligned on timeline, deliverables, and next steps.

  • Acting as the “ringleader” or project manager for POCs.

  • Pulling in Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) support when deeper or more complex technical work is needed.

REQUIREMENTS

  • AI/ML background and the ability to credibly discuss AI/ML topics with technical stakeholders.

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to run structured discovery and clarify ambiguous requirements.

  • Technical depth to scope solutions, without needing to write production code.

  • Ability to script and prototype as needed, including comfort “vibe coding” to move quickly in technical workflows.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience running or supporting benchmarks for ML inference deployments.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure tradeoffs relevant to inference performance and cost (for example GPU selection and latency versus throughput tuning).

  • Experience serving as a cross-functional technical lead for customer POCs, including coordination across Sales and Engineering.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).
